title: Analyst, Data Science
description:
JOB ID: TYA1445809

Job Title: Analyst, Data Science
Duration: 12 Month+
Location: Plano, TX

Company Background: Our client, a major employer in the area, is looking for an Analyst, Data Science to be part of its team in its North American operations.

Description:

Who we are:
  • Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Client. As one of the world's most admired brands, Client is growing and leading the future of mobility through innovative, high-quality solutions designed to enhance lives and delight those we serve. We're looking for diverse, talented team members who want to Dream. Do. Grow. with us.

What we're looking for
  • This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of computational science, data analysis, and business consulting. The ideal candidate will excel in manipulating, analyzing, and cleaning data, using predictive and prescriptive models to extract actionable insights that inform business decisions. They should also be proficient in programming with Python, leveraging it to build robust models and ensure seamless deployment from development to production. The ability to present results and recommendations effectively to business partners and leaders is essential. If you have a passion for end-to-end data solutions and enjoy working in a dynamic, collaborative setting, you could be the perfect fit for our team.

What you'll be doing
  • Work closely with team members and business partners to identify and prioritize key questions and drive impactful data-based decisions.
  • Extract, manipulate, and clean data from diverse sources using SQL and Python, preparing it for detailed analysis and model development.
  • Develop and implement sophisticated predictive and prescriptive models using statistical and machine learning techniques. Ensure these models address key business challenges and deliver actionable insights.
  • Create clear, compelling data visualizations to effectively communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Effectively and efficiently transition models from development to production within the organization's existing cloud ecosystem.
  • Software development with a Python environment
  • Participate actively in project planning and prioritization sessions to ensure data initiatives align with business goals.
  • Stay updated with the latest industry trends and tools and integrate this knowledge to improve methodologies and solutions.

Requirements:
Qualifications/ What you bring (Must Haves)
Master's degree or higher in a relevant analytical field.
  • Highly proficient with SQL
  • Hands-on experience with software development using Python Pandas, and Numpy
  • Experience solving problems using a variety of statistical and machine learning techniques.
  • Hands-on experience using statistical or machine learning frameworks to solve a variety of real-world problems (e.g., statsmodels, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc).
  • Knowledge of methods like Logistic Regression, Time Series Analysis, GLMs, Mixed Modeling, Multivariate Statistics, Predictive Modeling, Decision Trees, Gradient-Boosted Trees, Random Forests, and Neural Networks.
  • Proactive approach to identifying problems and developing innovative solutions.
  • Experience with version control in GitHub

Added bonus if you have (Preferred):
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices to streamline model deployment and code management.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based machine learning platforms (e.g., AWS SageMaker or Azure ML) to leverage scalable computing resources and tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, effectively navigating and prioritizing complex cross-departmental projects to drive impactful change.
  • Capability to replace and bridge existing legacy infrastructure and processes.
  • Experience with the Snowflake, Netezza, or Microsoft SQL environment
  • Experience with SAS programming language
  • Understanding of cashflow financial analysis and its implications for business strategy is highly desirable.

title: Commercial Escrow Officer
description:
Job Description:
  • Under direction of location manager or supervisor, conducts commercial closing services for complex sales and loan transactions, which often involve a number of unusual contingencies to the transaction.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Provides service to consummate commercial transactions involving large or multi-parcel sales and loans; interprets the varied and complex terms and contingencies contained in escrows.
  • Writes escrow instructions consistent with the general requirements of the parties and obtains their approval; orders and supervises preparation of legal papers, instructions, settlement sheets, and agreements.
  • Insures compliance with binder or commitment prior to closing transaction; reconciles discrepancies between instructions and title report with principals by modifying escrow instructions, assisting principals in obtaining releases of liens and other encumbrances, and obtaining copies of legal documents necessary to clear title.
  • Directs preparation, execution, and recording of notes, deeds, deeds of trust, and other authorized documents.
  • Directs computation of interest and the proration of taxes, hazard insurance, loan interest, rents and other prorated items.
  • Assists in maintaining computer in set up work for escrow special projects and prepares computer input sheets.
  • Directs and participates in the preparation of construction loan disbursement cases.
  • Correlates current survey to property description ascertaining its accuracy and completeness.
  • May train, assign, and review work of escrow technician and escrow closer.
  • May travel within area to perform real estate transac¬tion closings at other locations.
  • May contact present and prospective commercial customers to solicit title insurance business, ascertain service needs of the customer, and provide insurance services for the customer; performs public relations functions in accordance with the sales program of the office or area.
  • Processes escrow files by receiving and completing forms for deposit in escrow accounts, transmitting escrow instructions and other documents to lender, preparing additional documents and escrow instructions as requested by the principals, real estate agents, and attorneys, and forwarding necessary documents and information to title officer.
  • Closes escrow files by carrying out routine maintenance tasks such as receipting title insurance and recording fees from title officer and balancing file; drawing escrow closing statements showing debits and credits of parties involved; transmitting checks, closing statements, policies, etc. to the respective parties involved; and maintaining follow-up necessary for completion of transactions and issuance of policy.
  • Opens escrow files and sets up new files with appropriate information, obtaining necessary additional information from parties involved in transaction and preparing and transmitting escrow instructions to parties involved.
  • Proofreads and transmits title policies and other pertinent papers to parties involved.
  • Transmits disbursements of any monies held in escrow for payments of repairs, assessments, taxes, and for other purposes.
  • Assists customers by providing general information on company escrow services, procedures, and status of cases.
  • Performs clerical duties such as filing, answering phone, logging in cases, and typing forms and correspondence.
  • May maintain bookkeeping records on construction disbursement cases, post the appropriate accounts, and forward necessary information to headquarters.
  • May assist with conducting closings, as directed, where meeting with parties to the transaction is involved; may conduct such closings on cases of limited complexity and as directed by the supervisor.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
  • Thorough knowledge of the purpose and use of title insurance and sales and service techniques; legal descriptions, legal documents, escrow procedures, and terminology; and computing interest and prorating taxes.
  • Considerable knowledge of local techniques, procedures, and regulations involved in the escrow closing of real property; of interviewing escrow principals, writing escrow instructions, reviewing preliminary title reports, prorating taxes; and of the principles of mortgage lending and underwriting.
  • Considerable ability to interview escrow principals; to plan and carry out an efficient escrow closing program; and to establish and maintain harmonious and effective relationships with other employees and the public.
  • Analytical ability sufficient to perform assignments guided by general escrow procedures with minimal instructions from superior and to complete escrow cases requiring interpretation of highly involved terms and contingencies. Complexity of assignments requires meeting customer requirements and deadlines or a substantial monetary loss to the company may result.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, in person and by telephone.
  • Knowledge of the purpose and use of title insurance and of related services and of the purpose and terminology of legal instruments involved in escrow transactions and in the insuring of title to real property.
  • Ability to determine and prepare necessary forms to complete escrow transactions; to type forms accurately; to follow instructions; to make arithmetic computa¬tions; and to meet and deal with the public effectively.
  • Analytical ability sufficient to perform varied tasks of limited complexity guided by general company escrow procedures and escrow supervisor instructions.
  • Ability to operate a personal computer and to use common office suite software, such as word processing and spreadsheet applications.
  • Ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing, in person and by telephone.
EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND LICENSING
  • High school diploma/equivalent with courses in bookkeeping and mathematics with five years of escrow experience, including three years handling large residential or commercial closings, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Post-high school courses in real estate principles and real estate law desired.

We are multi-disciplinary with a broad spectrum of industry experiences and deep analytical and quantitative expertise. Bachelors/Masters degree in Statistics, Engineering, Operations Research, mathematics, risk management, finance or related fields.
Communicate ideas succinctly and accurately; tailor your communication to a broad range of audiences; active listening and good presentation skills.

  • Improve the process. Identify gaps; propose lightweight, repeatable improvements that raise reliability, safety, and engineering velocity.
  • Contribute to code & reviews. Participate in code reviews, create PRs where appropriate, and support CI checks tied to requirements and tests.

  • Automotive background (ADAS/ADS, chassis, powertrain, or similar safety-critical domain). (3 years)
  • Systems experience managing requirements and interfaces for complex embedded/vehicle systems and respective tooling such as Jama, Jira/Azure DevOps for tracking. (3 years)
  • Hands-on DRBFM leadership and follow-up through verified closure. (3 years)
  • Software literacy: C/C++ fundamentals; ability to read code and collaborate effectively with developers. (3 years)
  • Networking: Working knowledge of CAN/LIN/Ethernet and related tooling. (3 years)
  • Documentation: Clear, concise spec and requirements writing with strong attention to traceability and version control. (3 years)

  • Experience with requirements/tooling: Jama, or Polarion; Jira/Azure DevOps for tracking.
  • Test environments: MIL/SIL/HIL, CANoe/Vector toolchain
  • Scripting/analysis in Python and/or MATLAB/Simulink.
  • Familiarity with SOME/IP, diagnostics (UDS), and over-the-air update concepts.
  • CI/CD and code review workflows (Git, GitLab/Jenkins).

title: Systems Engineer IV
description:
Job Description
Day to Day Responsibilities of this Position and Description of Project:

Environment (context)
~14,000 employees; ~500 active Splunk users
~3 TB/day ingest from ~100 sources; NFS-backed storage
Sources span on-prem apps/appliances/network devices, SaaS, private cloud/K8s, Azure & AWS
The most important ways the person doing the job should spend their time are...
Keeping a multi-site Splunk Enterprise (indexer clustering + SHC) healthy: upgrades/patching, daily/weekly health checks, capacity & license management, DR tests.
Onboarding data cleanly and securely: forwarders/syslog/HEC; sourcetypes, props/transforms, timestamping/line-breaking, field extractions, retention.
Improving performance and reliability: monitor ingestion/search performance, queues, storage/bucket health; remove bottlenecks; tune searches and data models.
Enabling users: create/optimize SPL searches, dashboards, alerts; advise engineers, SREs, and SecOps on best practices and troubleshooting.

The most important duties are
  • Operate and harden a multi-site Splunk Enterprise environment (indexer clustering, SHC, deployer/deployment server, RBAC, app lifecycle).
  • Monitor and tune ingestion, search, and storage (RF/SF validation; bucket health; NFS tuning; queue depths).
  • Lead data onboarding projects across on-prem, SaaS, cloud (Azure/AWS), K8s; ensure auditability and data-handling policy compliance.
  • Build/optimize SPL, dashboards, alerts; coach consumers on SPL and performance patterns (tstats, accelerations, base/inline searches).
  • Maintain DR posture and execute/verify failovers.
  • What this job needs to be successful is (traits and characteristics)
  • 3–5+ years administering Splunk Enterprise at multi-TB/day scale, including indexer clustering and SHC in multi-site deployments.
  • Expert SPL and performance tuning (tstats, data models/accelerations, search optimization).
  • Deep data-onboarding skills (forwarders/syslog/HEC) and props.conf/transforms.conf mastery (timestamps, line-breaking, field extraction, value normalization).
  • Strong Linux admin + scripting (bash, Python); networking/TLS fundamentals.
  • Experience with NFS-backed indexers (operational tuning/gotchas).
  • Clear communicator with a customer-enablement mindset; documents well; bias for automation.

Nice-to-have:
  • Splunk Architect cert; experience with ES, ITSI, MLTK, and SOAR; familiarity with data-science/ML concepts (to partner with teams, not to lead research).
  • The simplest and easiest way to see that this job is done well is...
  • Cluster health green: RF/SF consistently met; successful failover tests.
  • Low ingest error rate and low data latency to index; stable license utilization.
  • Search KPIs: median and P95 search times within agreed SLOs; reduced scheduler/skipped search rates.
  • Clean data: correct timestamps, low unknown sourcetypes, stable field extraction accuracy.
  • User outcomes: growing self-service usage, actionable dashboards/alerts, and satisfied internal customers (shorter MTTR for incidents).
  • No audit/compliance exceptions related to Splunk data handling or access controls.
Basic qualifications
  • 3–5+ years hands-on Splunk Enterprise administration at scale (multi-TB/day), including indexer clustering, SHC, deployer/DS, license mgmt.
  • Strong SPL and performance tuning (tstats, DMs, accelerations, base/inline searches).
  • Data onboarding expertise: forwarders/syslog/HEC; props/transforms; timestamping/line-breaking; field extractions; retention planning.
  • Linux + scripting (bash/Python); networking/TLS fundamentals.
  • Experience operating with NFS-backed indexers.
Nice-to-have:
  • Splunk Architect cert; ES/ITSI/MLTK/SOAR; familiarity with data-science/ML concepts.

title: Systems Administrator V
description:
Position Title: Senior Collaboration Systems Administrator
Description:
Job Summary
  • As the Collaboration Systems Administrator, you will manage and support client's collaboration tools, including Email, Google Workspace, Office 365, Cisco CES, Ironport, and Microsoft Exchange, Slack, Lucidchart, Figma, Monday.com. Your role involves ensuring the seamless operation, support and integration of these platforms to drive efficiency and innovation across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Platform Management: Administer and maintain collaboration tools, including Google Workspace, Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft SharePoint and O365, Cisco CES and Ironport to meet client's evolving business needs.
  • Technical Support: Provide technical, escalation and backend support and solutions for collaboration systems.
  • Tool Integration: Assist in integrating various collaboration platforms to optimize processes and workflows.
    Innovation and Improvement: Investigate new technologies and methodologies to further enhance collaboration capabilities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with other departments such as service desk, Information security, networking, etc. to implement and refine solutions that boost productivity and efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate effectively with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver technology solutions that align with business objectives.
  • End-User Training and Support: Provide documentation to end-users, ensuring they can effectively utilize collaboration tools and systems.
  • Change Management: Coordinate, test, and plan changes to collaboration systems. Communicate these changes, which may include enhancements, maintenance, fixes, and emergency updates.

Required Qualifications
  • Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge and experience in managing collaboration platforms, including Email, Google Workspace, Office 365, Slack, Cisco CES, Ironport, Microsoft Exchange, and more.
  • Problem-Solving Abilities: Exceptional analytical skills, capable of addressing complex issues related to collaboration tools.
Communication Skills:
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with proficiency in U.S. English, able to effectively engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Large Corporate Environment Support: Has supported large environments with more than 10k users.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience: Senior level experience - 7+ years in roles focusing on collaboration platforms administration.
Education:
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Certification:
  • Relevant certifications in technologies related to collaboration tools.

Work Environment
  • Scheduled Weekly Hours: Typically 40 hours per week, with flexibility for different working styles.
    On-Call Responsibilities: We use a follow the sun model for on-call so the on-call shifts would be during the candidates normal shift working hours.
